variants.headline: Grant programme passes over needy districts
variants.body: A government grant programme has passed over districts that needed it. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Need goes unanswered in grant allocation
variants.body: Districts in need were passed over by a government grant programme. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Government grants miss the districts in need
variants.body: A government grant allocation has overlooked the districts that needed support. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
